user.title: Configure XGIMI projector
user.description: Enter the projector name and host, then choose the wake backend.

data_description.wake_backend: Choose Local Bluetooth for this Home Assistant host, or ESP32 to press a Home Assistant button. The backend cannot be changed after setup.

local.title: Configure local Bluetooth wake
local.description: Enter the projector BLE token and choose a concrete local adapter that supports BLE advertising.

data_description.token: Hexadecimal manufacturer-data value from key 70; do not include the key itself.
data_description.bluetooth_adapter: Only discovered local adapters with BLE advertising support are listed.

esp32.title: Configure ESP32 wake
esp32.description: Choose any Home Assistant button or input button entity. Turning on the projector presses this button once.

data_description.wake_button: The selected button is called with button.press or input_button.press. The integration does not inspect its state or require ESPHome.

error.invalid_host: The hostname or IP address is invalid.
error.invalid_token: The token must be 1–16 bytes of hexadecimal data.
error.invalid_adapter: Choose one of the discovered advertising-capable adapters.
error.invalid_button: Choose a Home Assistant button or input button entity.

abort.no_local_adapter: No advertising-capable local Bluetooth adapter was found. Check the host Bluetooth service and adapter, or choose ESP32.

init.title: XGIMI integration settings
init.description: Configure common settings and the options for the selected wake backend.

data_description.alive_port: TCP port used to detect whether the projector is powered on. Defaults to 554.
data_description.scan_interval: How often the projector power state is refreshed, in seconds. Defaults to 30.
data_description.debug_logging: Log detailed wake and local BlueZ activity. Disabled by default.
data_description.bluetooth_adapter: Choose a discovered local adapter with BLE advertising support.
data_description.advertisement_duration: How long each local Bluetooth advertisement is registered, from 1 to 10 seconds.
data_description.ble_increment: When enabled, the first send uses the configured token; each later send increments byte 0 modulo 256. The counter is memory-only and resets after restart.
data_description.wake_button: The selected Home Assistant button is pressed once for each wake request.

error.invalid_adapter: Choose one of the discovered advertising-capable adapters.
error.invalid_button: Choose a Home Assistant button or input button entity.

dbus_unavailable.title: System D-Bus is unavailable
dbus_unavailable.description: The local wake backend cannot connect to system D-Bus. For Home Assistant Container, mount `/run/dbus:/run/dbus:ro` from the Docker host and add `NET_ADMIN` and `NET_RAW`.

bluez_unavailable.title: The host BlueZ service is unavailable
bluez_unavailable.description: Start the host BlueZ service and verify that Home Assistant can access it through system D-Bus.

no_local_adapter.title: No local advertising-capable Bluetooth adapter
no_local_adapter.description: No local Bluetooth adapter with BLE advertising support was found. Attach a Bluetooth controller to the host and check Settings → Devices & services → Bluetooth.

configured_adapter_missing.title: The configured Bluetooth adapter is missing
configured_adapter_missing.description: The selected local adapter is no longer present or no longer supports BLE advertising. Reconnect it or choose another concrete adapter in the integration options.

wake_backend_failure.title: The local Bluetooth wake backend failed
wake_backend_failure.description: The local wake backend could not transmit the advertisement. Check the integration diagnostics and local Bluetooth configuration.
